subject: EoQ credit request: CoreWave - CORE-586
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: EoQ credit request: CoreWave - CORE-586

Team — quick ask to get ahead of EoQ close. CoreWave (Justin Park / Sabrina Lowe) are ready to commit to Redwood Dedicated + Private control plane: estimated $150k ARR, 12-month term, start date early Jan. They went dark on Friday but re-engaged this morning and said a short-term credits incentive will get legal/ procurement to sign this week.

Why this matters: CoreWave is a platform-first analytics shop (APAC expansion in Q2) and this is a reference-scale account for our private deployment story. We also expect a follow-on POC for low-latency inference in H1. The deal velocity implies closed-won this quarter if we can offer a conversion credit.

Ask: approve a usage credit to be applied to their first 90 days. Requested amount = $40,000 (pre-tax credits), delivered as account credits (non-refundable) to be consumed against usage. Attached is a short credit memo and a draft addendum for legal to review.

Risk/mitigation: credits only apply to consumption (no cash payment), will be amortized against ARR and require a signed 12-month commitment. CS will own onboarding plan and success milestones; I can attach the timeline.

Timing: Need signoff before EOD 12/31 to get the addendum into DocuSign and avoid slipping to Jan.

Attachments: credit-memo_CoreWave_20261230.pdf (pdf, 46KB), credit-addendum_CoreWave_draft.docx (docx, 28KB)

Thanks — I know timelines are tight, happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 12:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EoQ credit request: CoreWave - CORE-586

Laura — thanks for the write-up and the attachments. Finance / RevOps here.

Approve in principle but with conditions:
- Cap credit at $30,000 (we can make an exception for EoQ pressure).
- Credits must be documented as 'usage credits' in the addendum and explicitly not refundable or transferable.
- We require the signed 12-month term and a short statement of expected initial usage (estimate attached in memo).
- Revenue recognition and ANNUAL CONTRACT VALUE implications: credits will be recognized as contra-revenue over the first 90 days; legal to confirm.

Please route the final addendum to finance@redwood.com and legal@redwood.com for stamping. If Marcus wants to push higher, we can escalate to exec review but won't make a last-minute cash concession.

Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EoQ credit request: CoreWave - CORE-586

Thanks both. Marcus here — I'm comfortable approving $30,000 credit for CoreWave given strategic lift and reference potential, provided we lock the following:
- 12-month signed commitment (no early termination credits).
- Onboarding kickoff within first 2 weeks of Jan and a CS-assigned success plan signed by the customer.
- The credit is a consumption credit, expires after 90 days, and we capture an explicit acceptance clause in the addendum.

Laura, please confirm CS owner and attach the onboarding timeline to the DocuSign package. Aditya, route to legal/finance and stamp the final doc; I'll sign manager sign-off now.

Subject: Re: EoQ credit request: CoreWave - CORE-586

Justin / Sabrina — great to reconnect. Short note to confirm next steps and the incentive we discussed.

What we agreed internally (final): Redwood can offer CoreWave a $30,000 usage credit to be applied against your first 90 days of consumption. Conditions: 12-month signed term, credit applied only to consumption (non-refundable), and CS will run a prioritized onboarding plan during the first two weeks of January.

How credit will be delivered: we'll attach an addendum to the master services agreement; it will include the credit language and the consumption-only clause. Once signed, the credits will automatically be applied to your billing as they are consumed. I've attached the addendum draft and the credit memo for your records. DocuSign link below for the addendum so legal can get the signature flow started: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/CORE-586-addendum

Internal approvals (excerpt):
> "Approve in principle but with conditions: Cap credit at $30,000 ..." — Aditya Rao, RevOps
> "I'm comfortable approving $30,000 credit for CoreWave given strategic lift and reference potential" — Marcus Lin, Sales Manager

Next steps for CoreWave:
- Review & sign addendum via DocuSign (link above).
- Kickoff call: Jan 4, 2027 (CS will reach out to schedule).
- Provide initial usage estimate (we'll attach to HubSpot).

Attachments: credit-memo_CoreWave_20261230.pdf, credit-addendum_CoreWave_draft.docx

Happy to hop on a quick call today if you want to run through the addendum before signature.

—
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
